name: Process and format audio video transcripts
description: Users asked the AI to process audio or video transcripts by transcribing them from voice, adding punctuation, removing filler words, or extracting specific segments like viral clips and dialogue boundaries. They also requested formatting adjustments such as segmenting text, removing timestamps, or analyzing the roles and content within meeting or call records.
